derivation: from H7874 (שִׂיד)lemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד;

occurrences.text: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
